summary: Defines a light source for 3D rendering, with point, cone, and distant light modes plus color, dimmer, attenuation, projector-map, shadow, and light-view controls.

key_params.name: dimmer
key_params.note: Light intensity multiplier; values below .001 are ignored by Render TOP lighting

key_params.name: lighttype
key_params.note: Point, Cone, or Distant light behavior

key_params.name: coneangle
key_params.note: Full-intensity cone angle for cone lights

key_params.name: conedelta
key_params.note: Outer falloff angle for cone lights

key_params.name: projmap
key_params.note: Projector map TOP for light projection

key_params.name: shadowtype
key_params.note: Off, hard mapped, soft mapped, or custom shadow map mode

key_params.name: shadowcasters
key_params.note: Geometry COMPs that cast shadows from this light

key_params.name: projection
key_params.note: Projection mode when viewing through the light

key_concepts: Light COMP casts light into 3D scenes and can also be used as a camera-like view into the scene.
Point lights radiate in all directions, cone lights behave like spotlights with cone and falloff controls, and distant lights use direction while ignoring position.
Dimmer changes intensity without changing hue, and values below .001 let Render TOP skip the light's compute cost.
Distance attenuation, projector maps, two-sided lighting options, and Light Mask controls shape how geometry receives the light.
Shadow settings render a depth-only shadow map used by Render TOP, with hard, soft, or custom shadow-map modes.
common_gotchas: Lights must be listed in the Render TOP's 'lights' parameter to take effect.
Distant lights ignore position and use direction only, which can surprise rigs that animate light translation.
Cone Angle and Cone Delta jointly control spotlight shape; outside the cone delta no more cone light is cast.
Dimmer values below .001 are ignored for compute, so a nearly off light may disappear from render contribution.
Shadow maps require shadow casters and matching Render TOP support; soft shadows increase sampling cost.
Projector maps use their own extend, filter, anisotropy, and projection settings, separate from ordinary material textures.
build_relevance: 2021.10000+ 3D scene lights, projector maps, and shadows
